purpose: Contract governance, SDK distribution and cross-repository compatibility. Not a runtime gateway.

services.auth: Appwrite session JWT; Backend validates and derives identity
services.notes: Backend is the only public product API runtime and canonical authority for local and remote social relationships, public posts and privacy. It transactionally enqueues opted-in public posts for Federation and rechecks public eligibility on object dereference.

services.auth: Obtains Appwrite JWT and sends it only to Backend public API
services.notes: Flutter obtains Appwrite session JWTs and calls only the Backend public API. The shared OpenAPI contract is the source of truth for contracted public operations, including the applicant-scoped native identity application/evidence/status/provisioning routes. Applicant and verification-session tokens are limited to their own identity operations; the Appwrite JWT is used for final approved provisioning redemption. Flutter must never receive service tokens, storage-provider keys, database credentials or private service URLs.

services.auth: PLATFORM_INTERNAL_TOKEN for protected writes; public config read is restricted to enabled public keys
services.notes: The pinned Backend mainline contains a typed Data Centre media client and matching client tests for all five private media lifecycle routes (upload-url, verify, status, download-url and delete). API cross-repository CI statically verifies those routes against the Data Centre handler, OpenAPI snapshot, Backend Compose network and dedicated service-token wiring. Live B2/R2 provider write/read/hash/replication/delete/restore acceptance remains pending. The dedicated media service does not yet have a verified Instabox adapter or full-inventory reconciliation; the separate Fresh API runtime still needs a Data Centre-backed adapter and canonical metadata-ledger reconciliation before its media flag can be enabled. The separate Data Centre platform event/audit/config API has no verified typed Backend client; video and notification services need separately audited contracts.

services.auth: Public objects by policy; private media requires expiring key-bound playback authorization; purge uses PURGE_TOKEN
services.notes: The pinned Go CDN requires a trusted origin service credential, forwards Backend viewer assertions only for private requests, requires explicit Backend visibility classification for public cache misses, bypasses shared cache for private responses, and has fail-closed denial/redirect/range/HEAD tests. Backend PR #206 now implements the canonical ready/public origin branch and method-correct GET/HEAD signing; Backend issue #205 remains open for handler-level PostgreSQL/storage integration tests across the public/private/deleted/quarantined matrix. Data Centre issue #53 remains open because immutable Go CDN deployment, external smoke and rollback are not yet evidenced. The Cloudflare R2 Worker remains unrouted.

authority: signed delivery of Backend-authorized public Create activities
public dereferencing of Backend-canonical ActivityPub Notes
services.auth: Public ActivityPub ingress uses HTTP Signatures; Backend-to-Federation uses a distinct service bearer; Federation-to-Backend uses a different service bearer
services.notes: Backend publishes authorized activities to the private /internal/v1/activities ingress using a dedicated direction-specific service bearer and activity ID idempotency key. Federation authenticates the ingress, verifies Backend actor eligibility, durably enqueues the outbox item and acknowledges 202 only after acceptance. Federation-to-Backend uses a separate bearer. Public routing, inbound activity projections, delivery workers and external-peer interoperability remain gated; durable acceptance is not proof of delivery.

authority: ranking order and ranking scores only
services.notes: Backend submits at most 200 already-authorized candidates to POST /v1/feed/rank and requests at most 50 results. The pinned Backend client and Algorithm OpenAPI agree on the path and API-version/service-bearer headers. Backend rejects unknown/duplicate IDs and rechecks current authorization before hydration. Staging service-authentication, timeout/fallback and load acceptance remain required.
